afterFileEdit.command: bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.md|*.markdown|*.mdx) .devbox/nix/profile/default/bin/bun x oxfmt --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac'

afterShellExecution.command: bash -c '.devbox/nix/profile/default/bin/bun x oxfmt --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "**/*.{md,markdown,mdx,js,jsx,ts,tsx,mjs,cjs,json,jsonc}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; .devbox/nix/profile/default/bin/bun x oxlint --fix . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'
